mn = min(w)\n    amax = max(abs(x) for x in w)\n    i_amax = max(range(n), key=lambda j: abs(w[j]))\n    l2 = math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in w))\n    return mean, var, mx, mn, amax, i_amax, l2\n\n# global per-column (hidden unit) stats of W1\nn_in, n_h = 500, 32\ncolstats = [rowstats([W1[i][j] for i in range(n_in)]) for j in range(n_h)]\nprint(\"\\nW1 per hidden unit j: mean var amax(i) l2\")\nfor j in range(n_h):\n    m,v,mx,mn,amax,i_amax,l2 = colstats[j]\n    print(f\"j={j:2d} mean={m:+.3f} var={v:.3f} amax={amax:+.3f}@in{i_amax} l2={l2:.2f}\")\n\n# per input row stats, sorted by l2\ninstats = []\nfor i in range(500):\n    w = W1[i]\n    l2 = math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in w))\n    amax = max(abs(x) for x in w)\n    i_amax = max(range(32), key=lambda j: abs(w[j]))\n    instats.append((l2, amax, i_amax, i))\ninstats.sort(reverse=True)\nprint(\"\\nTop 25 inputs by row L2:\")\nfor l2, amax, j, i in instats[:25]:\n    r, c = divmod(i, 5);
